keeling-curve.def: The record of atmospheric carbon dioxide measured at Mauna Loa Observatory, Hawaii, since 1958 by Charles David Keeling and later NOAA. It rises every year with a small seasonal cycle.

ice-core.def: A long cylinder of ice drilled from a glacier or from the thick ice of Antarctica or Greenland. Bubbles of air trapped in the ice record past greenhouse gas levels going back hundreds of thousands of years.
